messages:
kevin: Deploybot started a canary v2.3.0 -> 5% in eu-central during the change window. Noticing embed p95 ~+90ms. tagging @nina @ops id=1859990000

deploybot: Deploy started: v2.3.0 -> 5% (eu-central). Snapshot: embed_p95 +92ms vs baseline, errors 0.12% (baseline 0.05%). Pause: `/deploy pause 1859990000`. Pin: `/deploy pin --region eu-central --rev v2.2.5`.

nina: Quick triage: seeing kvcache churn and a concurrent disk IO spike on node-3. Pulling dmesg and pod logs to correlate.

ops: Given late window, prefer pin and observe for 7m. If p95 doesn't return within +15ms, quick vote for rollback.

kevin: Actioned: eu-central pinned to v2.2.5 and canary paused (1859990000).

nina: After pin and targeted cache warm, p95 returned to within +8ms in ~2m. Disk IO spike is from a snapshot job; ops to terminate.

ops: Snapshot job killed, metrics stable. No customer-facing errors. My vote: +1 keep pinned and schedule a controlled dry-run with warmed caches. -1 would be full rollback.

kevin: Vote +1 keep pinned. I'll file a follow-up triage ticket and add a warmup step to the deploy playbook.

deploybot: Canary remains paused at 0% (1859990000). Recommendation: schedule a controlled dry-run in next daytime window with cache-warm and node IO checks.
